purpose: Record a concrete pre-December-2025 public JAX geometry/PCA implementation that is strongly compatible with the JAX ArrayImpl and PCA family observed in the historical Point_data artifact, without claiming historical producer identity.

coord_eig_decomp.signature: coord_eig_decomp(coords, robust=True, center=False, PCA=True, sort=True, transpose=True)

relation_to_historical_point_data.temporal_relation: the GeoJax implementation predates the December 2025 Point_data ingest by approximately 10 months
not_proven: The exact December 2025 producer used this GeoJax commit.
The exact GeoJax revision installed in the producer environment.
The exact conversion path from vector results to scalar JAX ArrayImpl DataFrame cells.

lineage.interpretation: 4dfc82b is the public entry point for the PCA/robust/JAX family; 33b0f872 is the last public GeoJax head observed before the December 2025 Point_data ingest.

mechanics_observed: initialize location with coordinate-wise arithmetic mean
initialize covariance using jnp.cov(..., rowvar=False, bias=True)
compute squared Mahalanobis distances using inverse covariance with 1e-6 diagonal regularization
use unit weights inside c^2 and c^2 / distance outside
stop when location movement is below tol or max_iter is reached

coord_eig_decomp.signature: coord_eig_decomp(coords, robust=True, center=False, PCA=True, sort=True, transpose=True)

implementation.vector_layout: eigenvectors returned as rows when transpose=True
implementation.degenerate_cloud_behavior: returns zero eigenvalues and identity eigenvectors if all coordinates are close to the first coordinate

align_point_cloud.signature: align_point_cloud(coords, order, target_basis, robust=True, center=True, center_coord=zeros(3))

parameters.order: Required caller-supplied eigenvector index order; no default order is specified

align_point_cloud.internal_eigendecomposition_call: coord_eig_decomp(centered, robust=robust, center=True, PCA=True, sort=True, transpose=True)
align_point_cloud.sign_rule: sign(sum(E * target_basis, axis=1)) is applied per eigenvector before alignment
align_point_cloud.transform: R = pinv(target_basis) @ E_adjusted; coordinates are returned after rotation/recentering
align_point_cloud.output_limit: returns aligned point-cloud coordinates; it does not directly emit the historical Subtype_evDir_x/y/z fields

proven: By 2025-05-02, the public GeoJax code exposed a JAX PCA/eigendecomposition routine and an alignment routine with caller-supplied eigenvector order and target basis.
The public implementation included configurable eigenvector sign alignment relative to the target basis.
These operations existed in the public source before the December 2025 Point_data.pkl artifact.
not_proven: That the December 2025 Point_data producer called align_point_cloud or coord_eig_decomp from this snapshot.
The actual order argument or target basis used for any T4/T5 subtype.
That the returned aligned coordinates or internal eigenvectors were used to generate Subtype_evDir_x/y/z.
The exact GeoJax revision or local modifications present in the producer environment.
provenance_boundary.interpretation: This is a concrete pre-artifact mechanism for configurable PCA axis selection and sign orientation, not producer identity or proof of any subtype-to-PC mapping.
